How to use

  • Press 3–4 drops into damp skin as the last step at night.
  • Use as the base for a 1% dilution of your favourite floral oil.
  • Massage into scars and dry patches daily.

Dilute before applying to skin and patch-test first. Not for internal use.

Scent profile

  • Warm seed
  • Faint earth
  • Nutty finish

What's in it

  • 100% cold-pressed unrefined Rosa canina seed oil

Who it's for

Dry or mature skin

Absorbs quickly and leaves very little residue, which is unusual for an oil this rich.

Anyone diluting essential oils for the face

A carrier that is doing something in its own right rather than simply providing volume.

Night routines

Best as the last step on damp skin, where it has hours to work and no makeup to sit under.

What people get wrong

Storing it in a warm bathroom. Unrefined rosehip is high in unsaturated fats and turns faster than almost any other carrier. It belongs in the fridge once opened, and it will smell unmistakably off when it goes.

Using too much. Three or four drops covers a face. People use a pipette-full, find it greasy, and conclude the oil is too heavy when the dose was the problem.

What it won't do

This is a carrier oil, not an essential oil — it is pressed from seed rather than distilled, and it has no aroma to speak of. If you are looking for scent, this is not the bottle.

It is also not a replacement for sunscreen, a moisturiser with humectants, or anything prescribed to you.

We describe how our oils smell and how people use them. We don't make medical claims, because essential oils aren't medicine.

Questions about Rosehip Renewal

Does it need to go in the fridge?

Once opened, ideally yes. Unrefined rosehip is high in unsaturated fats and oxidises quickly at room temperature, especially in a warm bathroom. Refrigerated, it will comfortably last the season.

Why is it orange, and will it stain?

The colour comes from carotenoids in the unrefined seed oil. At the few drops you should be using it will not stain skin, but it can mark a light pillowcase if you apply it heavily right before bed.

Can I use it with my other products?

Yes, as the last step. Oils seal in what is underneath, so apply water-based serums first and rosehip afterwards, onto damp skin.

How long does it keep once opened?

Around a year for a cold-pressed oil like this one — less in a warm bathroom. Keep the cap tight and store it somewhere cool and dark. If it starts to smell like old crayons, it has turned and should not go on skin.

Do I need to dilute it?

No — this is the carrier. It goes on neat, or it is what you dilute essential oils into. For a 2% blend, add about 12 drops of essential oil per 30 ml.
